name: A Plan Generations in the Making
Decoys and Misdirection
community_notes: [APPROX] After deployment, select up to 3 GENESTEALER CULTS units and redeploy them; the option to place redeployed units into Strategic Reserves regardless of the reserves cap is unmodeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Priority Target
community_notes: Selected via cult sniper rifle hits; only friendly Genestealer Cults models' attacks against the marked unit benefit.

name: Living Up to Legend
community_notes: [APPROX] After a friendly KILLER unit's attacks destroy an enemy unit or CHARACTER, each visible battle-shocked GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" is no longer battle-shocked; the kill trigger and the battle-shocked/visibility filter are captured as an opaque grant, as no remove-battle-shock effect exists. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Inhuman Reactions
community_notes: When an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of an unengaged PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit, that unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

name: Fanatical Hail
community_notes: [APPROX] When a NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit is selected to shoot, its ranged attacks may re-roll hit rolls against one selected enemy unit; modeled as a re-roll of failed hits, not restricted to the single chosen target. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Slunk From the Underbelly
community_notes: [APPROX] While a NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit with every model in a terrain area is targeted in your opponent's Shooting phase, ranged attacks against it have -1 AP (modeled as +1 to the attacker's AP characteristic) until that unit has attacked. The terrain-area and 'until it has attacked' conditions are simplified. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Integrated Tactics
community_notes: [APPROX] When an ASTRA MILITARUM unit is selected to shoot, mark one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to it; GENESTEALER CULTS ranged attacks against the marked unit get +1 to Hit. Unmodeled: the ASTRA MILITARUM unit being locked to only target the marked unit, and the 18" selection range. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Brood Brothers
community_notes: [APPROX] Army-construction rule — permits including ASTRA MILITARUM allied units up to a points cap, with keyword exclusions, a GENESTEALER CULTS Warlord requirement, and loss of the Voice of Command ability. The build restrictions are unmodeled by design. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Hypermorphic Fury
community_notes: ABERRANTS, BIOPHAGUS and PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS units get +1 to Charge rolls; if such a unit made a Charge move this turn, melee weapons get +1 Attack until the end of the Fight phase.

name: Psionic Parasitism
community_notes: [APPROX] At the end of your Movement phase, for each TYRANIDS SYNAPSE unit, a friendly TYRANIDS unit within 9" heals up to D3+1 lost wounds and gets +1 to Hit until your next Movement phase. Unmodeled: the per-Synapse repetition, the D3+1 mortal wounds inflicted on the paired GENESTEALER CULTS unit, and the Catalyst aura the rule grants to TYRANIDS units. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: A Perfect Ambush
community_notes: When a GENESTEALER CULTS unit is set up as Reinforcements, its weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] until the end of your next Fight phase (modeled as a grant triggered on arrival).

name: Deeds that Speak to the Masses
